problem_statement: The livestream flag review queue stops draining whenever it reaches a request for a flagged stream that is still inside its review window. ActionRequester.process_queue raises ValueError('audit channel accepts critical alerts only') and every request behind it in the queue is left unprocessed. Warning-level reports are meant to go to the reviewers' digest only. Please fix this so the queue drains; tests/test_pipeline.py::test_flag_inside_review_window_does_not_stop_the_queue reproduces it. Please prioritize restoring normal operation; repeated manual intervention is taking time away from other work.
